Title: Newbie question: Political Action stealth bonuses

Messages.Author: jj
Messages.Body:
The rules say that Political Action cards automatically get +1
stealth. All the Political Action cards that I've seen out of the base
set also say +1 stealth. Does this mean that Political Action cards
get +2 stealth or is the card just restating that Political Action
cards get a default +1 stealth? TIA!

Messages.Body:
